description: A utility class providing methods for keyword processing, including tokenization, stemming, stop word filtering, and keyword expansion based on thesaurus relationships, used within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: KeywordSearchUtil
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for processing keywords, including tokenization, stemming, stop word filtering, and thesaurus-based expansion.

methods.name: getSeparators
methods.description: Retrieves the string of separator characters used for tokenizing keywords.

methods.name: getStopWordBagOr
methods.description: Retrieves the stop word bag for OR conditions.

methods.name: getStopWordBagAnd
methods.description: Retrieves the stop word bag for AND conditions.

methods.name: getRemoveStems
methods.description: Determines whether stemming should be removed based on configuration.

methods.name: getStemSet
methods.description: Returns a set of stem suffixes used for stemming keywords.

methods.name: processForKeywords
methods.description: Processes input string into keywords with options for search, prefix/suffix wildcards, and logical AND filtering.

methods.name: processKeywordsForIndex
methods.description: Processes input string into keywords for indexing, with specified separators and stop word filters.

methods.name: fixupKeywordSet
methods.description: Cleans and filters a set of keywords, removing stop words, stems, short tokens, and applying wildcards for search.

methods.name: makeKeywordSet
methods.description: Tokenizes a string into a set of keywords based on separators, with special handling for search wildcards.

methods.name: fixKeywordsForSearch
methods.description: Adjusts a set of keywords for search, applying stemming and wildcards.

methods.name: expandKeywordForSearch
methods.description: Expands an entered keyword using thesaurus relationships, possibly replacing the original keyword.
